newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan auctions 6-mo bonds in special operation.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan auctions 6-mo bonds in special operation.

text.p: The State (central) Bank of Pakistan said it had auctioned short-term federal bonds worth a total of 2.88 billion rupees in a special open market operation on Sunday.
It said bids worth 3.68 billion rupees were submitted by banks, but only 2.88 billion rupees were accepted for the outright sale of the six-month bonds at a maximum cut-off of 15 percent per annum.
In the previous operation on November 14, bids worth 2.65 billion rupees were submitted, but only 400 million rupees were accepted.
